title: Billing Hooks Integration Test Plan (Replay + Invoice Parity)
content:
Purpose
- Validate end-to-end correctness of billing hooks by replaying production-like telemetry through the metering pipeline and comparing outputs at each stage (raw telemetry -> billing-ready aggregates -> invoice line items).
- Provide repeatable evidence for Finance close controls and auditability requirements: every billed unit is explainable from source telemetry with documented transformations.

Non-goals
- This is not a full billing system replatform or a replacement for unit tests at the SDK/runtime level.
- Not attempting to simulate every possible model/region combination; focus is on meter definitions, edge cases, and known failure modes (streaming disconnects, retries, rounding, timezone).

Owners / approvals
- Engineering owner: Cole Summers (billing hooks + quotas)
- Metering pipeline owner: Nadia Rahman
- Telemetry/analytics: Logan Wright
- Observability/alerts: Allison Grant
- Finance sign-off: Emily Stone (billing controls). Exec escalation: Laura Bennett.
- Program coordination: Talia Benson

Scope under test
- Hosted API: chat/text generation token meters (input/output/cached), embeddings units, rerank units, request count, streaming accounting.
- Dedicated: usage attribution into commit burn-down vs overage buckets (at least one representative scenario; deeper attribution tests tracked separately).
- Export schema: meter_version, aggregation_window, invoice_run_id presence and stability.
- Console alignment is out of scope for this test plan except where it impacts invoice aggregation invariants (timezone normalization, model alias mapping).

System under test (SUT) - components / boundaries
1) Source telemetry events (request-level + token accounting signals)
   - Includes: request_id, org_id/account_id, project_id (if present), model, endpoint_type, region, timestamps, token counts, streaming events, retry signals.
2) Metering events normalization + enrichment
   - Adds: meter_version, request_outcome/retry_reason (where implemented), pricing dims (tier/plan where applicable).
3) Aggregation job(s)
   - Windowing rules (hour/day/invoice cycle)
   - Rounding rules per ADR-027
4) Invoice aggregator
   - Produces invoice-ready line item rows with mapping to telemetry dims
5) Billing export
   - The file/rows Finance uses for invoice generation and reconciliation

Test environments
- Local (developer): minimal smoke runs against dockerized stack, used to validate replay harness wiring.
- Staging: primary environment for replay + parity assertions (writes to staging datasets only).
- Prod-shadow (read-only inputs): optional path to pull redacted event samples from prod; never writes results to prod billing tables.

Environment constraints / safety
- Replay jobs MUST write to a dedicated namespace (e.g., billing_replay_*) and use a distinct invoice_run_id prefix: REPLAY-<yyyy-mm-dd>-<gitsha>.
- Any alerting (meter anomaly alerts) must be suppressed or routed to a dedicated channel during large replays/backfills to avoid false positives (coord with Allison).

Replay dataset strategy
Data sources
- Golden files: curated, versioned event bundles representing known edge cases and typical traffic.
- Sampled production-like bundles: pulled from prod telemetry for a fixed 24h window, then redacted (PII removed) and normalized for determinism.

Redaction
- Remove/replace: prompt text, user identifiers, IPs, customer-provided metadata.
- Keep: org/account surrogate keys, request ids (can hash), timestamps, model/region/endpoint, token counts, streaming events, retry signals.

Determinism requirements
- Replays should be deterministic given the same inputs and code SHA.
- Any non-deterministic ordering must be normalized (sort by request_id + event_seq before aggregation).
- Timezone must be pinned to UTC in replay unless explicitly testing timezone behavior.

Golden file versioning
- Golden bundles are stored in repo (or artifact store) with schema version. Each bundle includes:
  - bundle_id
  - recorded_at window
  - meter_version expectation
  - expected aggregate outputs (billing-ready + invoice line item rows)
- Updating golden expectations requires:
  - link to ADR / change rationale
  - Finance acknowledgement if invoice totals would change (even in replay)

Integration test matrix (high-level)
Legend
- Input: replay bundle
- Assertion point(s): where we compare
- Pass criteria: exact match or within tolerance

A) Baseline correctness
A1. Single request, non-streaming, no retries
- Input: 1 request event with known input_tokens/output_tokens
- Assert: billing-ready aggregate tokens match exact; invoice line item totals match exact
- Pass: exact equality

A2. Multi-request mixed models/regions
- Input: 100–1,000 requests across 2 models, 2 regions
- Assert: aggregates group by (org_id, model, region, endpoint_type)
- Pass: exact equality per group

B) Streaming + disconnect accounting
B1. Normal streaming completion
- Input: stream_start + partial_token events + stream_end
- Assert: billed output tokens equal emitted tokens; request_count = 1
- Pass: exact equality

B2. Client disconnect mid-stream
- Input: stream_start + partial_token events + disconnect
- Assert: do not bill tokens after disconnect; ensure partial usage captured
- Pass: exact equality; includes explicit check that post-disconnect token events are excluded
- Notes: validates fix in PR redwood/pr_41903

B3. Partial stream with retry
- Input: disconnect -> retry request (new request_id) succeeds
- Assert: billing rules for retries apply (see section D)

C) Rounding + aggregation windows (ADR-027)
C1. Per-request rounding removed; rounding at aggregation/invoice level
- Input: multiple requests with fractional units at intermediate steps (where applicable)
- Assert: no per-request rounding; only final aggregation rounding per meter definition
- Pass: exact invoice totals per expected rules
- Notes: validates PR redwood/pr_41888

C2. Window boundary behavior
- Input: requests around 00:00:00 UTC boundary
- Assert: assigned to correct aggregation_window; invoice cycle totals stable
- Pass: exact grouping; no double-counting

D) Retries, failures, and request_outcome
D1. Network retry (client-side) that results in duplicate request payload
- Input: two requests; first fails before completion, second succeeds
- Assert: only billed tokens consistent with meter definitions (usually: successful tokens billed; failed requests may have partial input processing depending on implementation)
- Pass: matches expected outcome; request_outcome dimension populated when enabled

D2. Server 5xx after some tokens emitted
- Input: request emits partial output then errors
- Assert: partial tokens billed per documented behavior (must match hosted-api-meter-definitions-v3); error flagged in request_outcome
- Pass: exact match

D3. Explicit non-billable outcomes
- Input: requests tagged non_billable (internal/test org) or outcome = rejected
- Assert: excluded from invoice aggregates; still visible in raw telemetry
- Pass: invoice total excludes

E) Caching/batching impacts
E1. Prefix/KV cache hit
- Input: requests with cache_hit=true and cached_tokens metric
- Assert: cached_tokens metered per definition; ensure not counted as both input_tokens and cached_tokens unless defined
- Pass: exact match per meter

E2. Continuous batching
- Input: batched requests share runtime batch_id
- Assert: billing is per-request (not per-batch); no cross-request token leakage
- Pass: exact match per request aggregation

F) Embeddings and rerank meters
F1. Embeddings units
- Input: embedding requests with known input token counts and embedding unit definition
- Assert: embedding_units computed per definition; rounding as specified
- Pass: exact match

F2. Rerank units
- Input: rerank requests with N documents
- Assert: rerank_units = N (or defined formula); request_count correct
- Pass: exact match

G) Export schema / auditability
G1. meter_version present and correct
- Assert: billing export rows include meter_version; stable across run
- Pass: exact match; non-null

G2. invoice_run_id propagation
- Assert: replay invoice_run_id appears in downstream aggregates and export; no mixing between runs
- Pass: exact match; uniqueness constraints satisfied

H) Negative tests / failure modes
H1. Missing required dimensions
- Input: events missing region or model
- Assert: pipeline either rejects with explicit error OR assigns to "unknown" bucket per documented behavior (must be consistent)
- Pass: behavior matches documented choice; alerts emitted

H2. Duplicate events (idempotency)
- Input: same event duplicated (same request_id + event_seq)
- Assert: counts not doubled
- Pass: exact match; dedupe mechanism validated

Tolerances / acceptance thresholds
- Golden bundles (curated): exact equality required for invoice totals and billing-ready aggregates.
- Production-like sampled bundles:
  - Per-dimension token totals: within 0.10% OR within 10 tokens (whichever is larger) due to known sampling/redaction transforms.
  - Request counts: exact match.
  - Embedding/rerank units: exact match.
- Any deviation must be triaged and labeled as:
  - (a) harness issue
  - (b) expected behavioral change (requires documented decision + Finance sign-off)
  - (c) bug

Execution procedure (staging)
1) Select replay bundle(s)
   - bundle_id: <fill in>
   - code SHA: <fill in>
2) Run replay ingest
   - Writes normalized events to staging table: billing_replay_events_<bundle_id>
3) Run metering pipeline + aggregations
   - Ensure aggregation_window configured for replay (do not pollute real staging invoice runs)
4) Generate invoice-ready export
   - invoice_run_id = REPLAY-<date>-<sha>
5) Compare outputs
   - Diff 1: raw replay aggregate vs billing-ready aggregates
   - Diff 2: billing-ready aggregates vs invoice line item mapping
   - Diff 3: export schema validation (presence, null checks, uniqueness)
6) Emit a replay report artifact
   - Summary counts, diffs, pass/fail, links to tables/queries
   - Store in shared drive folder: shared_drives/engineering/platform-engineering/billing-replay-reports/

Evidence artifacts (what Finance needs)
- Replay report (single doc) containing:
  - bundle ids executed
  - invoice_run_id(s)
  - pass/fail per matrix category
  - diff summaries with tolerances
  - pointers to staging datasets/tables and query links
- Screenshot or exported CSV of final invoice line item rows for at least one golden bundle
- Confirmation that meter_version and invoice_run_id are present in export (schema check output)

Sign-off criteria
Engineering sign-off (Platform)
- All golden bundles pass in CI and staging.
- No P0/P1 open issues in billing hooks related to correctness (exceptions documented).
- Replay report published with links and reproducibility steps.

Finance sign-off (Billing Controls)
- Emily Stone reviews replay report and confirms:
  - invoice line item totals match expected outputs for golden bundles
  - any known deltas are documented with decision record / acceptance rationale
  - evidence is sufficient for close checklist and audit trail
- If any change would affect real customer invoices, Finance requires:
  - quantified impact estimate
  - rollout plan + communication plan
  - explicit approval from Laura Bennett (as needed)

Operational notes / known gaps (as of 2026-02-12)
- request_outcome/retry_reason dimensions are landing (ENG-4823). Until merged everywhere, retry tests should be marked "expected partial" and focus on invoice totals rather than dimension-level splits.
- Dedicated attribution tests are currently minimal; deeper commit burn-down parity testing should be tracked as a follow-up (tie to SUP-3129 doc gap).
- Large replays can trigger meter anomaly alerts; coordinate suppression windows with SRE per Allison.

Open questions
- Do we want a standard monthly cadence to run the full golden suite prior to invoice close (tie to INT-944 close checklist update)?
- What is the authoritative tolerance definition for sampled production bundles (0.10% vs fixed-unit thresholds) and who owns updates (Finance vs Eng)?

Changelog
- 2026-01-18 (Cole): initial draft: harness outline + matrix skeleton
- 2026-02-03 (Nadia/Logan): added retry + streaming edge cases, schema checks
- 2026-02-12 (Emily): requested clearer Finance evidence list + explicit acceptance thresholds (incorporated)
